### Schneider National, Inc. announces quarterly dividend


October 28, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s28.q4cdn.com/901178831/files/doc_news/Schneider-National-Inc--announces-quarterly-dividend-832d5e5ff-2026.pdf)


GREEN BAY, Wis.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Schneider National, Inc. (NYSE: SNDR), a premier multimodal provider of transportation, intermodal and logistics services, announced today that on October 26, 2026, its Board of Directors declared a quarterly cash dividend of $0.10 per share on its Class A and Class B common stock, payable to shareholders of record as of December 11, 2026. The dividend is expected to be paid on January 12, 2027.


**About Schneider**


Schneider is a premier multimodal provider of transportation, intermodal and logistics services, helping customers turn supply chain complexity into greater control. Backed by more than 90 years of operational expertise and innovation, Schneider delivers reliable, flexible and responsible solutions that help businesses move freight with confidence.

includes[Regional](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fschneider.com%2Ffreight-shipping-solutions%2Fregional-haul&esheet=54629733&newsitemid=20261027460973&lan=en-US&anchor=Regional&index=1&md5=80738877319d6cecbe314204b68d16fd)
